title: Emerald Fantasea | Scenic Stays
meta_description: Welcome to Emerald Fantasea, your enchanting retreat nestled in the heart of Navarre, where coastal charm meets modern comfort. This enchanted three-bedroom, two-bathroom property invites you to experience the perfect blend of luxury and relaxation against the stunning backdrop of the Emerald Coast.
description_expanded: Welcome to Emerald Fantasea, your enchanting retreat nestled in the heart of Navarre, where coastal charm meets modern comfort. This enchanted three-bedroom, two-bathroom property invites you to experience the perfect blend of luxury and relaxation against the stunning backdrop of the Emerald Coast. As you step into Emerald Fantasea, you are greeted by a spacious open designed living space that seamlessly connects to the fully equipped kitchen. The open floor plan creates a welcoming atmosphere, perfect for entertaining or enjoying quiet family moments. Natural light floods the interior, accentuating the tasteful decor and high-end finishes throughout. The master bedroom is a sanctuary of tranquility, boasting a king-sized bed and an ensuite bathroom. Two additional well-appointed rooms offer comfortable sleeping arrangements for family or guests of up to 6. Step outside onto the private patio and experience the true essence of coastal living. A lush, landscaped backyard provides an ideal setting for morning coffee or evening gatherings. Emerald Fantasea offers an additional delight for families with a playset for kids in the backyard. Children can frolic and play, adding an extra element of fun to your stay. Emerald Fantasea is ideally situated, just minutes away from the pristine beaches of Navarre. Explore the sugar-white sands and crystal-clear waters or indulge in water activities such as paddleboarding and snorkeling. Additionally, the property is conveniently located near local dining, shopping, and entertainment options, allowing you to immerse yourself in the vibrant culture of the Emerald Coast. Whether you're seeking a romantic getaway, a family retreat, or a gathering of friends, Emerald Fantasea provides the perfect canvas for creating lasting memories. Book your stay at this Scenic Stays property today and create lasting memories in this coastal paradise.  Parties, events, bachelor and bachelorette parties are strictly prohibited, and an adult chaperone must accompany guests under 25 throughout their stay. Smoking is strictly forbidden, and pets are unfortunately not welcome and subject to immediate departure if found to be inhabiting a property. Guests found in violation are subject to eviction with no refund.
